article.headline: Ian Jackson, Keyshawn Hall score 17 points apiece as No. 13 St. John's routs Colgate 90-59
article.description: — Ian Jackson and Keyshawn Hall scored 17 points apiece, leading No. 13 St. John’s to a 90-59 victory over Colgate on Wednesday night.
article.linkText: Ian Jackson, Keyshawn Hall score 17 points apiece as No. 13 St. John's routs Colgate 90-59

categories.description: Colgate Raiders @ St. John's Red Storm

event.description: Colgate Raiders @ St. John's Red Storm

keywords: Colgate Raiders @ St. John's Red Storm
article.story: NEW YORK -- — Ian Jackson and Keyshawn Hall scored 17 points apiece, leading No. 13 St. John’s to a 90-59 victory over Colgate on Wednesday night. Tounde Yessoufou followed up his 23-point showing against Iona with 15 points, four rebounds and three steals. Lefteris Liotopoulos contributed 13 points as the Red Storm outscored Colgate 51-27 in the final 23 1/2 minutes. Ruben Prey finished with 11 points and eight rebounds, and new point guard Quinn Ellis, from England, added nine assists. Jackson made 6 of 10 shots, including three 3-pointers. Jackson, a preseason first-team All-Big East pick, scored 11 of his points over the final 3:34, when the Red Storm stretched a six-point lead to a 17-point margin by halftime. Hall made 5 of 9 shots and withstood a minor injury scare when he was fouled by Cameron Brennan with 6:45 left. Hall took a hard fall on the baseline, but got up after getting checked out and took two free throws before leaving the game for good. The Red Storm (3-0) shot 48.4% and went 12 of 30 from 3-point range in their second game at Carnesecca Arena on campus in Queens and earned their third straight double-digit victory. St. John’s also scored 27 points off 19 turnovers. The Red Storm finished with 11 steals. The Red Storm let a 15-point lead slip to 38-32 with 3:34 left, but scored the final 11 points of the first half for a 49-32 lead following Jackson’s coast-to-coast layup at the buzzer. The Red Storm continued pulling away and opened a 61-36 lead when Yessoufou and Jackson sank corner 3s early in the second half. Andrew Alekseyenko led Colgate (0-3) with 15 points and eight rebounds. The Raiders shot 37.7% and were 7 of 27 from 3-point range. Up next Colgate: Visits Delaware on Sunday. St. John’s: Hosts Syracuse on Sunday at Madison Square Garden ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
